Clause-②: yes (widening: `ObjectSchema.color` and `BlueprintObjectSchema.color` are new optional keys; `@object-ui/components` newly exports `ObjectIconTile`; nothing removed or renamed). The seat runs the L2 at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (new authorable spec property).
Metadata-protocol: added
Premise: re-read on main `8c8ff0f2` by the card thread: holds, with two corrections. (1) `packages/spec/liveness/object.json` needs a live reader for every object property, so PR 1 also switches the one shared navigation path (`resolveNavItemIcon` / `useNavTargetIcon`: the left menu and the app home menu list, phone included). (2) The step that turns an AI blueprint into objects is not in this repository; see Scope.
Basis: card #35985, a p2 child of epic #34571, which the maintainer handed to this seat on 2026-11-21 03:24:57Z (「34571 专题你也接手」).
Palette (the card leaves it to the dev; seat accepts): nine names, `gray` · `blue` · `teal` · `green` · `amber` · `orange` · `red` · `pink` · `purple`. They reuse the existing colour-variant names and add `gray` and `pink`. No semantic names (`success`, `danger` …), since an object colour tells objects apart and says nothing about state. An object without a colour draws as `gray`. The spec accepts only these names; any other value is refused with the nine listed.
Scope: PR 1 = the spec property (object and blueprint, one leaf), palette, ledger, upgrade note, the shared tile, the designer picker with colour preview and the object inspector, plus the navigation reader above. A menu item pointing at an object draws the tile: the glyph is the item's own icon if it sets one, and the colour is always the object's. Dashboard, page and link items keep the line icon. PR 2 (patch, `Fixes #35985`) switches every other place that draws an object icon; it is listed in its body, and it lands after #35918 (`objectViewPageHeader.tsx`). PR 3 (`domain:skills`) writes the colour names into the skills text. The acceptance line "AI builds a three-object app with three different colours" is verified in this repository at the blueprint schema and rule text. The end-to-end run needs the AI service, which lives outside this repository, to carry `color` through the way it carries `icon`. PR 3's body names that, and it is not a blocker for this card. (That acceptance line comes from the coordinator's own additions, not from the maintainer's words.)
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: serial; no fold. Overlap probe: only #35918 conflicts, on a PR 2 file. #35921, #35923 and #35977 touch `object.zod.ts` and merge cleanly; the probe is re-run before each push. The branch is the card thread's harness push branch, a measured platform exception to `claude/issue-<n>-<slug>`.
